about: FRONTIER 109 (b), rail run 260, 2026-11-27: would basementstudio/xmcp#821's planNanoPayment take the 402 of each seller skill/PAYABLE.md marks yes? Read as data from a blobless git clone at the merge commit; no xmcp code was run, no seller was called, nobody was contacted. test_xmcp_821_planner.py re-derives every planner cell from the seller fixtures with a Python reading of the lines named here.

lines.readOffer: nano-payer.ts:73-95 - the offer object, its JSON text, or a tools/call result's structuredContent or first text content; no accepts list throws 'Not an x402 offer: no accepts list' (:91-93)
lines.accept: nano-payer.ts:49 and :111-118 - the first accepts entry with scheme exact and network 'nano' or 'nano:mainnet' (constants.ts:17)
lines.payTo: nano-payer.ts:120-126 - payTo must pass isValidNanoAddress (nano.ts:197-216, blake2b-40 checksum) and allowedPayees when given
lines.amount: nano-payer.ts:128-136 - v2 reads amount, v1 maxAmountRequired; a positive whole raw <= 2^128-1 and <= maxAmountRaw
lines.binding: nano-payer.ts:144-158 - extra.binding absent, or exactly 'xno-binding/v1/rep' with a 22-128 char orderId (nano.ts:234-241)
lines.payload: nano-payer.ts:166-191 - after the payer's wallet has PUBLISHED the send, the payment is {x402Version, resource?, accepted, payload: {blockHash, orderId?}}
lines.transport: nano-payer.ts:9 and :164, provider.ts:166 - the payment goes in _meta['x402/payment'] of a retried MCP tools/call, not in an HTTP header

summary: Of the 16 PAYABLE yes sellers, #821's planner takes 11 offers (all x402 v2 exact on nano:mainnet, unbound) and refuses 5 (4 no accepts list; nanswap-nodes, x402 v1 on network nano-mainnet, no-exact-nano). End to end it pays 0: every seller is HTTP 402 and none reads a blockHash from MCP _meta; the 11 settle an unpublished payload.block, which #821 does not build (the queued payer-block follow-up, unopened, would add that payload but not the HTTP transport).
